hard_boundaries: No final BUY/SELL/entry/SL/TP/position size is generated by this mapping.

Similarity remains historical evidence only and cannot override hard gates.
2025 remains OOS read-only and cannot be used for tuning or calibration.
Existing book evaluators and frozen source knowledge must not be rebuilt.
